# Thesis: last-hour reversal where the close was more volatile than the open (flow, not news), blended with less common slow signals that carry most of the risk, so the mix differs from crowded reversal and fundamental alphas.
# Source: closing-pressure reversal (Bogousslavsky & Muravyev 2023); net issuance (Pontiff & Woodgate, JF 2008); cash-flow yield (Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny, JF 1994); accruals (Sloan, The Accounting Review 1996); stock-based pay as an intangible-investment proxy (our own hypothesis).
late = cs_rank(ts_mean(std_dev_return_last_hour/(std_dev_return_first_hour + 0.0001), 5)) > 1.5  # close more volatile than open
r = cs_zscore(at_zero2nan(-cs_rank(ts_mean(return_last_hour, 5)) * late))  # fade last-hour returns where the close was volatile
k1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(stock_based_compensation)/mktcap))  # stock-based pay per dollar of market value
k2 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 250) - 1))  # net issuance: short dilution, long buybacks
k3 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(free_cash_flow)/mktcap))  # free-cash-flow yield
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + 3*(at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3)))  # slow signals at triple weight

# Source: closing-pressure reversal (Bogousslavsky & Muravyev 2023); net issuance (Pontiff & Woodgate, JF 2008); cash-flow yield (Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny, JF 1994); accruals (Sloan, The Accounting Review 1996); stock-based pay as an intangible-investment proxy (our own hypothesis).

k1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(stock_based_compensation)/mktcap))  # stock-based pay per dollar of market value
k2 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 250) - 1))  # net issuance: short dilution, long buybacks
k3 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(free_cash_flow)/mktcap))  # free-cash-flow yield
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + 2*(at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3)))  # slow signals at double weight

# Source: closing-pressure reversal (Bogousslavsky & Muravyev 2023); net issuance (Pontiff & Woodgate, JF 2008); cash-flow yield (Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny, JF 1994); accruals (Sloan, The Accounting Review 1996); stock-based pay as an intangible-investment proxy (our own hypothesis).

ta = ts_fill(total_assets)  # total assets, filled between reports
k4 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank((ts_fill(net_income) - ts_fill(cash_from_operations))/ta))  # low accruals (cash-backed earnings)
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(r) + 2*(at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3) + at_nan2zero(k4)))  # four slow signals at double weight

# Source: closing-pressure reversal (Bogousslavsky & Muravyev 2023); net issuance (Pontiff & Woodgate, JF 2008); cash-flow yield (Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny, JF 1994); accruals (Sloan, The Accounting Review 1996); stock-based pay as an intangible-investment proxy (our own hypothesis).

# Thesis: many weak, slow accounting premia combined; each alone is noisy, but they are weakly related, so the composite is steadier. Turnover is tiny, so IR/sqrt(TVR) is high.
# Source: Sloan (The Accounting Review 1996); Cooper, Gulen & Schill (JF 2008); Pontiff & Woodgate (JF 2008); Lakonishok, Shleifer & Vishny (JF 1994); Chan, Lakonishok & Sougiannis (JF 2001); Novy-Marx (JFE 2013).
ta = ts_fill(total_assets)  # total assets, filled between reports
k1 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(stock_based_compensation)/mktcap))  # stock-based pay per dollar of market value
k2 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(shsout/ts_delay(shsout, 250) - 1))  # net issuance: short dilution, long buybacks
k3 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(free_cash_flow)/mktcap))  # free-cash-flow yield
k4 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank((ts_fill(net_income) - ts_fill(cash_from_operations))/ta))  # low accruals (cash-backed earnings)
k5 = cs_zscore(-cs_rank(ta/ts_delay(ta, 250) - 1))  # low asset growth
k6 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(research_and_development_expense)/mktcap))  # R&D per dollar of market value
k7 = cs_zscore(cs_rank(ts_fill(gross_profit)/ta))  # gross profit per dollar of assets
alpha = at_zero2nan(at_nan2zero(k1) + at_nan2zero(k2) + at_nan2zero(k3) + at_nan2zero(k4) + at_nan2zero(k5) + at_nan2zero(k6) + at_nan2zero(k7))  # equal-weight 7-signal composite
